<div id="abouten">
I'm a data scientist specialized in economics and finance. I try to solve real world problems with simple models.

In college, where I studied economics, I founded to analyze data and discovered my vocation there. Today I work at focused on time series analysis, econometrics, and machine learning applications, aiming to explain and predict the behavior of economic variables, allowing data-based decisions. My work has already helped over students.

My main skills in my are predictive models; time series; data analysis and visualization; data products such as reports and dashboards; and technologies such as R, Python, Git, GitHub, and SQL.

I love constantly learning new things, sharing knowledge openly and interacting with people on these topics.
